Joyful.text: Joy is not in things; it is in us.
Joyful.author: Richard Wagner

Joyful.text: The most wasted of days is one without laughter.
Joyful.author: E.E. Cummings

Joyful.text: Wherever you go, go with all your heart.
Joyful.author: Confucius

Joyful.text: Choose to be optimistic, it feels better.
Joyful.author: Dalai Lama

Calm.text: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
Calm.author: Buddha

Calm.text: The soul always knows what to do to heal itself.
Calm.author: Caroline Myss

Calm.text: Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience.
Calm.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Calm.text: Quiet the mind, and the soul will speak.
Calm.author: Ma Jaya Sati Bhagavati

Calm.text: Silence is the ultimate weapon of power.
Calm.author: Charles de Gaulle

Calm.text: Breathe. Let go. This moment is the only one you have.
Calm.author: Oprah Winfrey

Emotional.text: The only way out is through.
Emotional.author: Robert Frost

Emotional.text: Vulnerability is the birthplace of innovation, creativity and change.
Emotional.author: Brené Brown

Emotional.text: Tears are words the heart can't express.
Emotional.author: Unknown

Emotional.text: Whatever is whole was once broken.
Emotional.author: Unknown

Emotional.text: Be kind to yourself. You are doing your best.
Emotional.author: Unknown

Emotional.text: Feelings are just visitors, let them come and go.
Emotional.author: Mooji

Fatigue.text: Even a leaf falls to rest.
Fatigue.author: Unknown

Fatigue.text: Tired minds don't plan well. Sleep first, then plan.
Fatigue.author: Walter Reisch

Fatigue.text: There is virtue in work and there is virtue in rest.
Fatigue.author: Alan Cohen

Fatigue.text: Sometimes the most productive thing you can do is relax.
Fatigue.author: Mark Black
